summary: No security findings. Style JSON is bundled authored content; the new calling-station postflopValue block (thresholdPct 88) passes the existing parseStyle 50..100 check and maniac probabilities 0.6 sit within the validated range. No bot parameter reaches advice (REQ-035.3): postflopValueMove runs in src/bots/style.ts after recommend() and only reads its Recommendation; recommend receives adviceOptions plus equity, never the style, and src/advice imports nothing from src/bots. Legal actions only: the helper picks check/call out of view.legalActions, and it fires only for an advised bet (nothing owed, so check is legal) or raise (a bet is owed, so call is legal). The `as Action` cast would only be undefined if the advice engine broke that invariant; same as the existing Rock code, so no reachable path. No hidden information: it uses only PlayerView fields (players[].streetContribution, currentBet, seat, legalActions). No new randomness draws, so seeded replay stays deterministic. No new dependencies, I/O, secrets, or user input.
